title: Kailasa Temple, Ellora

groundCutout.basis: Documented 82 by 46 metre Kailasa court anchored to the native location. The carved floor and basalt scarp cover the entire opening. Source elevation remains independent.

terrainReference.basis: Original source grade west of the rock-cut courtyard entrance. The approximately 82 by 46 metre carved court and scarp require separate interpretation.

mapIdentity.scope: The native 22-vertex monument envelope records the location of the carved court. The documented 82 by 46 m measurement controls the extracted interior and the mapped extent controls the exterior cliff transition.

note: Known 32 m rear scarp, 8 m plinth, connected axial sanctuary and 31 m tower. Qualla originals document coarse ash-gray and ochre basalt, bands of carving, elephant supports and full depth of exposed faces.
